Intervention: Hepatitis B timely birth-dose vaccine: percentage of neonates vaccinated
Hepatitis B third-dose vaccine: percentage of infants vaccinated
Hepatitis B and C diagnosis and treatment
Hepatitis B diagnosis: percentage of people with chronic HBV infection diagnosed
Hepatitis B treatment: percentage of eligible people with chronic HBV infection treateda
Hepatitis C diagnosis: percentage of people with HCV infection diagnosed
Hepatitis C treatment: percentage of people with HCV infection treated
Safety of blood and health care injections
Blood safety: percentage of donated blood units screened for bloodborne diseases
Safe injections: percentage of injections in health care facilities that are safe
Harm reduction: annual number of needles and syringes distributed per person who injects drugs
